General.title: Australian Federal First Home Schemes & Grants Overview
General.portalName: Official Australian Government First Home Portal

sections.heading: Federal First Home Guarantee (FHBG) — 5% Deposit Scheme
sections.content:
Under the Federal Home Guarantee Scheme administered by Housing Australia, eligible first home buyers can purchase a residential property with as little as a 5% genuine savings deposit without paying any Lenders Mortgage Insurance (LMI). The Australian Government guarantees up to 15% of the loan value.

  • Low Deposit: 5% deposit for first home buyers, or 2% for single parents via the Family Home Guarantee (FHG).
  • No LMI: Saves borrowers between $15,000 and $35,000 in upfront insurance fees.
  • Property Types: New homes, established houses, townhouses, apartments, or house and land packages.
  • Unlimited Places: Available across major panel lenders through EZ Mortgage Broker.

sections.heading: First Home Super Saver Scheme (FHSSS)
sections.content:
Allows first home buyers to save money inside their superannuation fund at a concessional tax rate of 15% (compared to marginal income tax rates up to 47%).

  • Savings Cap: Release up to $50,000 of voluntary contributions per individual ($100,000 for a couple) plus associated compound earnings.
  • Annual Limit: Up to $15,000 per financial year in voluntary concessional/non-concessional contributions.

sections.heading: Federal Help to Buy Shared Equity Scheme
sections.content: The Australian Government contributes up to 30% equity for established homes or up to 40% equity for new builds, allowing buyers to purchase with just a 2% deposit and significantly lower monthly mortgage repayments.

VIC.title: Victoria (VIC) State Revenue Office — Grants, Exemptions & Concessions
VIC.portalName: Official State Revenue Office (SRO) Victoria Portal

sections.heading: First Home Buyer Land Transfer (Stamp) Duty Exemption & Concession
sections.content:
The State Revenue Office (SRO) provides substantial duty savings for Victorian first home buyers:

  • Full Stamp Duty Exemption ($0 Duty): Available if your first home has a dutiable value of $600,000 or less. You pay $0 in stamp duty (saving up to $31,070 in land transfer tax).
  • Sliding Scale Concession: A tapered duty discount applies for homes valued between $600,001 and $750,000.
  • Property Eligibility: Applies to new homes, established homes, and vacant land intended for home construction.
  • Vacant Land Assessment: Dutiable value is calculated strictly on the land price itself — building contract costs are not included.

sections.heading: Victorian First Home Owner Grant (FHOG)
sections.content: A direct $10,000 payment is available for first home buyers purchasing or building a new home with a contract price of up to $750,000.

sections.heading: Off-the-Plan & Strata Duty Concessions
sections.content:
Owner-Occupier Pathway: Reduces dutiable value by deducting construction costs occurring after contract signing.

Temporary Strata/Townhouse Extension (Active until 21 April 2027): Broad concession applying to all buyers (including investors, companies, and trusts) purchasing apartments, units, or townhouses in strata subdivisions with no property price cap.

sections.heading: Pensioner, Family & Special SRO Exemptions
sections.content:
• Pensioners & Concession Cardholders: Full duty exemption up to $600,000; partial discount up to $750,000 (one-time benefit for principal residence).
  • Spouse / Partner Exemption: Transfers of a principal home between legal spouses or de facto domestic partners are 100% exempt from stamp duty.
  • Principal Place of Residence (PPR) Concession: General stamp duty reduction for homes valued up to $550,000 if occupied for 12 continuous months.
  • Family Farms & Deceased Estates: Full exemptions apply for farming land transfers between immediate family and properties passed through wills.
  • Disability Exemption: Home transfers from immediate family to a qualifying person with a disability are exempt.

sections.heading: Applicant Eligibility & Residency Requirements
sections.content:
• Must be natural persons, at least 18 years old, and Australian citizens or permanent residents.
  • Must occupy the home as Principal Place of Residence for at least 12 continuous months, moving in within 12 months of settlement (or 12 months from occupancy certificate / 36 months from settlement for vacant land).
  • Defence Force personnel are exempt from residency requirements if enrolled on Victorian electoral roll.

sections.heading: How to Apply (Digital Duties Form)
sections.content: Your conveyancer or solicitor completes the official SRO Digital Duties Form online during settlement. All exemptions and concessions are calculated automatically and deducted directly from settlement funds.

NSW.title: New South Wales (NSW) — First Home Buyers Assistance Scheme & FHOG
NSW.portalName: Official Revenue NSW First Home Portal

sections.heading: First Home Buyers Assistance Scheme (FHBAS)
sections.content:
• Full Transfer Duty Exemption: Pay $0 transfer duty on new and established homes valued up to $800,000 (savings up to $30,735).
  • Concessional Transfer Duty: Tapered discount for properties valued between $800,001 and $1,000,000.
  • Vacant Land: Full exemption on vacant land up to $350,000; concession between $350,001 and $450,000.

sections.heading: NSW First Home Owner (New Homes) Grant
sections.content:
$10,000 cash grant for buying or building a brand-new home:

  • Newly constructed homes valued up to $600,000.
  • Comprehensive building contract to build valued up to $750,000.

sections.heading: Residency Criteria
sections.content: At least one buyer must move in within 12 months of settlement and reside continuously for at least 12 months.

sections.heading: Queensland First Home Owner Grant ($30,000)
sections.content: Queensland offers the highest state grant in Australia: a $30,000 direct cash grant for eligible first home buyers purchasing or building a brand-new home valued under $750,000.

sections.heading: First Home Transfer Duty Concession
sections.content:
• Full Duty Exemption ($0 Duty): Zero transfer duty on homes valued up to $700,000 (saving up to $17,350).
  • Concession: Tapered concession on properties valued between $700,001 and $800,000.
  • First Home Vacant Land Concession: Full exemption on vacant land valued up to $350,000; concession up to $500,000.

sections.heading: Residency Rules
sections.content: Must move into the property as principal residence within 1 year of settlement and live continuously for at least 1 year.

WA.title: Western Australia (WA) — FHOG & First Home Owner Rate (FHOR)
WA.portalName: Official WA Department of Treasury & Finance Portal

sections.heading: WA First Home Owner Grant (FHOG)
sections.content:
$10,000 cash grant for purchasing or building a new residential home:

  • Up to $750,000 for properties south of the 26th parallel (Perth and South West).
  • Up to $1,000,000 for properties north of the 26th parallel.

sections.heading: First Home Owner Rate (FHOR) Duty Concessions
sections.content:
• Full Stamp Duty Exemption: $0 transfer duty on homes valued up to $450,000.
  • Concession: Reduced rate on homes valued between $450,001 and $600,000.
  • Vacant Land: $0 duty up to $300,000; concession between $300,001 and $400,000.

SA.title: South Australia (SA) — $15,000 FHOG & Unlimited Stamp Duty Relief

sections.heading: Complete Stamp Duty Relief on New Homes (No Price Cap)
sections.content: South Australia offers complete stamp duty relief for eligible first home buyers purchasing brand-new homes, off-the-plan apartments, or vacant land for construction — with no property price cap.

sections.heading: First Home Owner Grant ($15,000)
sections.content: A direct grant of $15,000 is payable to eligible first home buyers entering contracts to buy or build a new home.

ACT.title: Australian Capital Territory (ACT) — Home Buyer Concession Scheme

sections.heading: ACT Home Buyer Concession Scheme (Zero Stamp Duty)
sections.content: The ACT operates a progressive buyer assistance scheme providing full $0 conveyance stamp duty exemption for eligible first-time and owner-occupier buyers across all residential properties (new and established) below qualifying household income thresholds.

TAS.title: Tasmania (TAS) — $10,000 FHOG & 50% Stamp Duty Discount
TAS.portalName: Official State Revenue Office of Tasmania Portal

sections.heading: Tasmanian First Home Owner Grant
sections.content: $10,000 cash grant for buying or building a brand-new home in Tasmania.

sections.heading: First Home Buyer 50% Duty Discount
sections.content: First home buyers purchasing an established home with a dutiable value of $600,000 or less receive an automatic 50% discount on transfer duty.

NT.title: Northern Territory (NT) — $10,000 FHOG & Territory HomeGrown Grants
NT.portalName: Official Territory Revenue Office NT Portal

sections.heading: NT First Home Owner Grant & HomeGrown Initiatives
sections.content: $10,000 grant for buying or building a new home, combined with Territory HomeGrown scheme incentives and territorial housing assistance.
